liveBaseline.name: Bible Copilot - AI Bible Study
liveBaseline.subtitle: Verse Meaning & Bible Answers
liveBaseline.description:
Understand Scripture with clear, verse-backed explanations and focused follow-up questions. Bible Copilot helps you move from a passage to its meaning, context, theology, application, and common questions without losing sight of the biblical text.

SIX STUDY MODES
- Summary: Get the central idea quickly.
- Observe: Notice structure, repeated words, and important details.
- Interpret: Explore context and meaning.
- Theology: Connect the passage to biblical teaching.
- Apply: Turn understanding into faithful practice.
- Apologetics: Examine questions and reasons carefully.

ASK FOLLOW-UP QUESTIONS
Start with a verse or passage, read its explanation, then ask the specific question the text raises for you. Continue the conversation without beginning your study again.

SAVE YOUR STUDY
Keep useful insights and return to them later. Use guided reading plans to build a consistent study rhythm.

FREE TO START
Ask up to 3 AI-powered questions each day at no charge.

BIBLE COPILOT PRO
- Unlimited questions
- Full access to Pro study features
- Monthly: $9.99
- Annual: $49.99 with a 7-day free trial

Payment is handled by Apple. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled through your Apple ID subscription settings.

Bible Copilot is a study aid, not a replacement for Scripture, prayer, church community, or qualified pastoral counsel.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://mybiblecopilot.com/privacy

candidate.name: Bible Copilot - AI Bible Study
candidate.subtitle: Verse Meaning & Bible Answers
candidate.treatment: Replace only the hidden keyword field. Preserve the live name, subtitle, description, screenshots, pricing, offer, and product behavior.
candidate.hypothesis: Replacing broad or overlapping tokens with exact product-supported study-intent tokens will improve non-brand discovery for verse explanation, commentary, inductive study, theology, and apologetics without weakening brand rank.

evidence.comparisonBoundary: Public search results and competing listing copy reveal positioning and rank observations, not keyword-to-download or keyword-to-subscription attribution.

prerequisites: Four unchanged weekly US rank snapshots
Fresh live metadata and product-truth verification
A version metadata window after the current 2.4.3 paywall treatment is released
Explicit owner approval before App Store Connect mutation
measurement: App Store Search impressions product-page views and first-time downloads
App Store Search paying users and currency-specific proceeds
First-question D1 D7 paywall and StoreKit guardrails
decisionPolicy.advance: At least 3 of 8 primary non-brand terms meet target, at least one reaches top 20, and comparable App Store Search first-time downloads rise 25% without worse activation, retention, paid-subscription, refund, or proceeds evidence.
decisionPolicy.boundary: Ranking movement is directional. Do not attribute installs, paid subscriptions, or revenue to a keyword without an Apple-supported join.
